_comment: Course-local objectives. The platform pack 'rust' indexes The Rust Programming Language chapters 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10, and content-packs/curriculum.json already carries one objective per indexed section; those 15 rust-ch* ids are reused unchanged by this course. The three objectives below cover what the course teaches but the pack does not index: the cargo toolchain (book ch. 1), reading rustc diagnostics, and the final project. Their sourceDocIds are deliberately empty - inventing chunk ids that do not exist in the pack would break grounding, and citing ownership chunks for a cargo objective would be dishonest. The consequence is stated in docs/SPEC.md 3.3: an objective without grounding drives mastery and progress but no proactive check-in.

rust.statement: Student can build, run and test a Rust package with cargo and locate the file a failing test points at.
Student can read a rustc diagnostic - error code, primary span, note and help - and act on it instead of guessing.
Student can build a small command-line tool that combines structs, collections, its own error type and a trait implementation, and prove it works with tests.
